items.title: Signature Global awards Rs 496 crore construction contract for Tonino Lamborghini residences
items.summary: Signature Global awarded a construction contract worth Rs 496 crore to B L Kashyap & Sons for a luxury project. This project, named 'Tonino Lamborghini Residences', will be located in Gurugram's Sector 71 and spans 12.40 acres. It consists of 812 premium flats and aims for completion in 5 to 6 years. Earlier, Signature Global partnered with Tonino Lamborghini to invest nearly Rs 2,900 crore for this housing project.

items.title: After Welcomhotel Manesar, ITC Hotels expands Delhi-NCR presence with 105-key Fortune Select Greater Noida
items.summary: ITC Hotels has signed a management agreement for the 105-key Fortune Select Greater Noida, expanding the brand’s presence in Uttar Pradesh and the NCR. Located at India Expo Plaza, the hotel will cater to corporate, MICE and leisure guests and is expected to open early next year.

items.title: SEBI pushes for resilient capital markets, focuses on investor protection: Chairman
items.summary: SEBI Chief Tuhin Pandey in Kolkata unveiled moves to deepen India’s capital markets, boosting access, efficiency, investor protection, and SME funding

items.title: Indian households shifting spending towards non-food items, services as consumption patterns evolve: Report
items.summary: Indian household consumption is likely to become increasingly diversified, with spending gradually moving beyond food essentials towards non-food products and services, as changing dietary preferences and household structures reshape consumption patterns, according to an SBI Research report.

items.title: Gold rate in India today: MCX gold falls 2.5% in a week - Buy at low price or avoid ahead of Diwali, Dhanteras 2026?
items.summary: Gold prices fell sharply in October as rising crude oil prices fueled inflation concerns and expectations that US interest rates would remain elevated.

items.summary: Q2 Results Today, 31st October 2026 Live Updates: businessline brings to you latest Q2 announcements, earnings updates and more.

items.title: How thematic investing is changing the way Indians approach crypto
items.summary: In India, investors are increasingly embracing thematic investing as they explore cryptocurrency and other sectors. This innovative investment style allows individuals to focus on specific trends and ideas rather than sticking to conventional categories. To support this, ZebPay has launched CryptoPacks, offering users curated portfolios that resonate with various themes. These packs simplify investment management and signify a shift toward future-focused digital asset strategies.

items.title: Cancer drug prices fell in 2019 too, but mark-ups of up to 700% are back
items.summary: The government's latest cancer drug price cuts may offer patients some relief, but the impact could be short-lived. An analysis of medicines covered in the 2019 exercise found that mark-ups had risen to as much as 700% by 2026, raising questions about whether one-time price cuts can keep cancer treatment affordable.

items.title: Stocks to buy: Sumeet Bagadia's top 3 stock recommendations — Sun Pharma, IndiGo, Infosys | Target price, stop-loss

items.title: Concurrent Gainers: 8 stocks that gain for 5 days in a row
items.summary: Eight BSE 500 stocks gained in each of the five sessions between October 26 and 30, delivering cumulative returns of 10% to 21%.

items.title: Karnataka sugarcane growers stage demo to press for their demands, district officials impose restrictions
items.summary: Farmers in North Karnataka are intensifying their protest over the procurement price of sugarcane and other related issues. They staged blockades and sit-ins across several locations including Belagavi and Dharwad. The farmers are demanding a fair price of Rs 5,500 per tonne for sugarcane and other reforms. Local administrations have imposed prohibitory orders to prevent further protests on highways.

items.title: Lodha Developers makes NCR market debut with ₹1,700 crore office project
items.summary: The Mumbai-based developer is expanding beyond its traditional markets as it prepares a residential launch in Gurugram and builds a ₹20,000 crore housing launch pipeline for the second half of FY27.

items.title: Vande Bharat is the fastest, but Tejas arrives early: Chennai to Madurai Vande Bharat, Vaigai superfast trains face 8-17 minutes delay while Tejas express reaches destination before scheduled time
items.summary: Vande Bharat is the fastest train from Chennai to Madurai, but it runs 17 minutes late on average. Vaigai is eight minutes late. Tejas Express arrives 12 minutes early. A six month check shows speed is not everything, and the viral Vaigai claim does not tell the full story.

items.title: Lodha Developers rides housing boom in Q2, but keeps one eye on a bigger threat
items.summary: Lodha Developers experienced a 10% rise in sales bookings, reaching Rs 5,037 crore in the second quarter. The company's pre-sales for the first half of the fiscal grew by 7% to Rs 9,670 crore. Lodha has set an ambitious target of Rs 24,000 crore in sales bookings for the current fiscal year. The company also reported a net profit increase of 28% to Rs 1,013.5 crore for the quarter.

items.title: ET Wealth Expo: Why market veteran S Naren thinks investors are getting gold, silver and asset allocation all wrong
items.summary: ICICI Prudential MF's S Naren warns investors against chasing assets after spectacular rallies, highlighting how silver's 216% surge drew record ETF inflows before a 27% correction. At the ET Wealth Expo, he explained why genuine asset allocation means buying unpopular assets and why gold still deserves a place in portfolios.

items.title: UP's first Vande Bharat Sleeper is here! New Delhi-Varanasi train: Timings, stoppages & ticket prices; PM Modi says it will connect faith with modernity
items.summary: Varanasi-Delhi Vande Bharat Sleeper launched: Indian Railways on Saturday expanded its Vande Bharat Sleeper network with a new service connecting Varanasi and New Delhi, offering passengers a faster and more comfortable overnight travel option. The service will improve rail connectivity between the two destinations, benefiting pilgrims, tourists, students, business travellers and working professionals.

items.title: Who is Rocco Basilico and why the Ray-Ban heir has rejected a $3.9 billion buyout offer for stake in family firm Delfin?
items.summary: A family dispute at Delfin has escalated after Rocco Basilico turned down a $3.9 billion buyout offer from Leonardo Maria del Vecchio for his 12.5% stake. Basilico reportedly wants $4.8 billion, while three shareholders are seeking to ease rules governing board changes.

items.title: F&O Talk: Big break above 23,200 can open doors for 23,500 for Nifty; Sudeep Shah picks 6 stocks ahead of Diwali
items.summary: Nifty could extend its recovery towards 23,500 if it decisively breaks above the 23,150–23,200 resistance zone, says SBI Securities' Sudeep Shah. He also shares his outlook on IT, midcap and smallcap indices, sector trends and six stocks, including TVS Motor, Coforge and ICICI Bank, ahead of Diwali.

items.title: Mumbai local train impacted: Cloth entangled in OHE disrupts services towards CSMT; office-goers face delays
items.summary: Local train services on the Harbour line were disrupted during the morning rush hour due to an incident. A piece of cloth got entangled in the overhead equipment at Sewri station at 9.45 am. This caused a halt of services from Wadala and a temporary shutdown of power. Commuters experienced delays of 15 to 20 minutes during peak travel times. Train services were fully restored by 10.

items.title: Trump called out Big Oil profits. Here’s how much their refining earnings have surged since
items.summary: Trump criticized Big Oil for making “too much money,” but oil majors have since reported surging refining earnings as fuel supplies tightened.

items.title: AI is coming to construction sites. But does it make workers safer?
items.summary: AI is flagging hazards on construction sites, but researchers say evidence that the technology prevents injuries remains limited.

items.title: Dividend, stock split, bonus record date alert 2-8 Nov week: Infosys, Mazagon Dock, Coal India, Sanofi and other shares
items.summary: Around 50 companies have corporate-action record dates next week, including Infosys, Asian Paints and Coal India. Concord Biotech has a 1:1 bonus issue record date on November 4, while Gujarat Natural Resources and Knowledge Marine have stock-split record dates on November 5 and 6.

items.title: Bengaluru to become fastest-growing city as global companies home in on talent: Savills Exec
items.summary: Global corporations are increasingly considering diverse locations, particularly India, for talent acquisition and growth. Bengaluru is projected to be the fastest-growing major city by 2035, according to Savills analysis. Other Indian cities like Chennai and Hyderabad are also showing strong potential in terms of GDP growth and population increase. The demand for global capability centers in India is expected to continue rising in the future.

items.title: Ratnadeep Retail gets SEBI’S nod for ₹400 crore IPO
items.summary: The Hyderabad-based company plans a 400 crore fresh equity issue plus an OFS of up to 1.49 crore shares by promoter selling shareholders, per the DRHP

items.title: IREDA appoints ex-REC executive Jatin Kumar Nayak as CMD
items.summary: Jatin Kumar Nayak has taken charge as the Chairman and Managing Director of Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency. Before this position, he served as Executive Director of Finance at REC Ltd and has three decades of experience. His previous roles include working with NHPC, Hindustan Copper, and National Aluminium Company Ltd. Nayak holds a Master's degree in Commerce and is a qualified Company Secretary.

items.title: IPO ahead: Value-fashion retailer Ratnadeep Retail gets Sebi nod to raise funds through public issue
items.summary: Ratnadeep Retail has received Sebi approval to launch an IPO comprising a fresh issue of up to Rs 400 crore and an offer for sale of 1.49 crore shares. The Hyderabad-based retailer plans to use part of the proceeds to repay borrowings and expand its store network across India.

items.title: Silver hits 11-month low at ₹1.9 lakh per kg in Delhi; crashes to $49/ounce globally
items.summary: Silver fell after slight gains, dropping ₹8,300 to ₹1,90,200 per kg from ₹1,98,500

items.title: Faster than Vande Bharat: 49-year-old Vaigai Express hits 110kmph speed, reaches Madurai in just 5 hours 35 minutes, two hours earlier despite leaving late from Chennai covering 430 km
items.summary: Vaigai Express service has been running since 1977. The Vande Bharat on the same corridor started only in 2023. On October 24, running late and through two delays, the Vaigai still matched the Vande Bharat’s Chennai-Madurai time of 5 hours and 35 minutes. Some things just do not get old.

items.title: Domestic coal production shielding India from global price swings: Coal secretary
items.summary: When the conflict in West Asia disrupted LNG and LPG supplies from late February, coal stocks at mines and power plants allowed the government to assure the country of steady power

items.title: SEBI imposes ₹1 crore fine on CDSL for multiple compliance lapses
items.summary: CDSL had failed communicate reasons for rejection of pledge requests to the depository participants of both the pledgor and pledgee, SEBI said

items.title: Diesel shortage lifts India’s exports to 12-month high in October
items.summary: Diesel shipments from India hit 700,000 barrels per day (b/d) last month, compared to 620,000 b/d during September, according to Kpler data

items.summary: West Asia supply recovery, Atlantic cargoes bolster crude intake significantly

items.title: Three stocks with strong order books to watch amid India's data-centre boom
items.summary: L&T, Power Mech Projects and Sterlite Technologies are positioned across construction, power and optical connectivity as India's AI and data-centre infrastructure spending gathers pace.

items.summary: Caution certainly seems warranted for the coming weeks

items.summary: Central bank considers lifting threshold on higher-risk mortgages in response to calls from government and industry to boost home-ownership

items.summary: Steep fall in Brazilian real has made the country’s exports more competitive, undermining pricing power for farmers in other countries

items.title: Diljit Dosanjh sends strong message at Aura tour in Delhi, says 'don't teach Punjabis how to fight'
items.summary: Diljit Dosanjh commenced his India leg of the Aura tour at Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium, attracting numerous fans. The concert faced initial uncertainty due to security concerns but proceeded with enhanced measures in place. During the performance, Dosanjh expressed gratitude to fans, while also addressing his critics. He performed popular songs and engaged actively with the audience throughout the evening.

items.title: Diwali stock picks: SBI Securities lists 11 stocks with up to 22% upside potential. Do you own any?
items.summary: SBI Securities has picked 11 stocks for Samvat 2083, with up to 22% upside potential. The list spans steel, hospitality, jewellery, electronics and infrastructure.

items.title: Oil prices soar 14% in October to 6-month high as US weighs fresh Iran strikes after midterms. More pain ahead?
items.summary: Brent crude rose 13.6% in October to settle at a six-month high of $117.64 a barrel, as fears of fresh US strikes on Iran and threats to shipping through the Strait of Hormuz fuelled supply concerns. Analysts warn of further volatility, with Goldman Sachs flagging a possible rise to $120.

items.title: 'Took stock of our bilateral cooperation': EAM Jaishankar meets US Secy of State Rubio on sidelines of G20
items.summary: S Jaishankar held a bilateral meeting with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio in Atlanta. The meeting focused on enhancing India-US cooperation and addressing geopolitical issues. Jaishankar emphasized that military solutions are not viable for resolving global challenges. Rubio also highlighted the importance of protecting economic and maritime security during the discussions. The G20 Foreign Ministers' Meeting concluded with crucial dialogues on international economic stability.

items.title: LIC Housing Fin Q2 net profit grows 12% YoY
items.summary: LIC Housing Finance experienced a 12% year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit, reaching ₹1,507 crore. Total income for the quarter rose by 1.5% compared to the previous year. A notable improvement in asset quality contributed to the positive financial outcome and led to the reversal of impairment charges. Gross non-performing assets decreased significantly, highlighting better loan performance during the quarter.

items.title: New India slips into red with 1,267 cr loss in Q2
items.summary: New India Assurance Company has revealed a concerning net loss of ₹1,267 crore for the September quarter, sharply contrasting with last year's profit of ₹63 crore. The sharp downturn is attributed to underwriting losses in key segments such as property, motor, and health insurance. Despite this, gross written premiums showed a modest increase of 5.14% year-on-year, totaling ₹11,083 crore.

items.title: Bank of Baroda's Q2 profit surges 36% YoY on NSE stake sale
items.summary: In a remarkable financial performance, Bank of Baroda reported a staggering 36% rise in net profit for the second quarter, reaching ₹6,532 crore. This surge was propelled by significant non-interest income, recoveries from previously written-off accounts, and gains from the partial sale of its stake in the National Stock Exchange.

items.title: Nasdaq 100 Falls 3% as Earnings Stoke AI Reckoning: Markets Wrap
items.summary: The Nasdaq 100 fell about 3%. Intel Corp. sank 28% as its outlook missed estimates. Amazon.com Inc. dropped amid greater capital spending

items.title: Reliance Retail Q2 profit takes a hit on Qcomm push
items.summary: Reliance Retail Ventures reported a significant drop in net profit, down 24.5% year-on-year to ₹2,619 crore in the last quarter. Despite this, revenue improved by 5.8% to ₹80,220 crore, largely driven by a surge in grocery sales. The company's profitability was affected by strategic investments and evolving festive season patterns, alongside rising finance costs stemming from increased borrowing and interest rates. Focus remains on improving transactions and business model adaptation.

items.title: 80 feet above ground, 3 railway lines below: Nagpur Metro's 257-metre bridge uses construction technique that eliminates the need for scaffolding
items.summary: Nagpur Metro is constructing a 257-metre-long elevated bridge nearly 80 feet above railway tracks at Uppalwadi as part of its Phase-II expansion. The structure will cross three railway lines and is being built using the balanced cantilever technique, eliminating the need for scaffolding beneath it. The project is part of the 6.92-km Reach-2A corridor towards Kamptee.

items.title: Wealthy Indians sit on cash, prepare to deploy funds across markets over next 12-24 months: Joint MD & CEO Systematix Private Wealth
items.summary: Wealthy Indian investors are holding liquidity and planning phased investments across diverse market segments. The focus is on both domestic and international markets, including the US, China, and South Korea. Private markets and credit opportunities are also gaining traction among ultra-high-net-worth individuals. Real estate investments are evolving with increased interest in Alternative Investment Funds, which have doubled over the last year.

items.title: Jio Platforms profit zooms 14% on healthy user mix, digital play
items.summary: Jio Platforms has unveiled an impressive 14% net profit growth to ₹8,387 crore for the September quarter, achieving a milestone subscriber count of 542 million, which includes 300 million utilizing 5G services. Revenue from operations climbed to ₹40,475 crore, fueled by a surge in digital services and a boost in average revenue per user, now at ₹218.8.

items.title: Airtel Africa Q2 profit rises 16% to $254 million
items.summary: Airtel Africa has revealed a remarkable 15.9% jump in its quarterly net profit, reaching $254 million, fueled by robust revenue growth. The total revenue escalated to $1.97 billion, showcasing a 25.7% rise in reported currency. Operating profit surged by 28.5% to $659 million, while customer numbers soared by 11.6%, pointing to the growing demand for data and mobile money services. The company achieved a record underlying Ebitda margin of 50.

items.title: Indian Oil net profit triples YoY to 21,630 cr in Q2
items.summary: Indian Oil experienced a remarkable surge in its net profit, which soared to ₹21,630 crore for the second quarter. This growth can be attributed to elevated pump prices and government subsidies for LPG sales. In contrast, the same quarter last year showcased a profit of only ₹7,610 crore. Moreover, operational revenue increased by 29%, reaching ₹2,62,935 crore, with the firm's operating profit from petroleum product sales more than doubling.

items.title: GAIL Q2 profit surges over two fold YoY to 4,650 cr despite global disruptions
items.summary: GAIL (India) has reported a remarkable increase in net profit, reaching ₹4,650 crore for the September quarter, more than double from the previous year. This growth is attributed to heightened gas marketing margins amid global energy supply disruptions. Revenue also surged by 31% to ₹45,924 crore. Furthermore, GAIL has moved forward with plans to list its subsidiary GAIL Gas, enhancing its stock value by 1.7% to ₹168 per share.

items.title: ZEE profit sinks 40% YoY in Q2, but revenue rises on FIFA subscription growth
items.summary: Zee Entertainment Enterprises faced a sharp drop in consolidated net profit for the quarter ending September 30, 2026, despite a 13% rise in operating revenue to ₹2,225 crore, spurred by FIFA World Cup-related subscriptions. Total costs surged by 18%, largely due to inflated programming and promotional expenses. In a bright spot, ZEE5's revenue surged over twofold, showcasing a successful digital approach.

items.title: India lifted 49.6 crore people out of poverty between 2011 and 2023, says World Bank report - Here is how it was done
items.summary: The World Bank says India lifted an estimated 496 million people out of poverty between 2011 and 2023. Extreme poverty fell from 27.1% to 2.6%, driven by consumption growth, rising employment—particularly among women—and expanded social transfers.

items.title: Lodha Developers profit rises 28% YoY to Rs 1,013 crore in Sept quarter
items.summary: Lodha has announced a remarkable 63% surge in net profit, reaching ₹2,386 crore for the first half of FY27. This growth is driven by impressive operational performance, with net profit for the September quarter rising by 28% to ₹1,013 crore and revenue climbing 18% to ₹4,468 crore. The company’s pre-sales also saw a 10% increase to ₹5,037 crore, alongside plans for expansion in NCR and Bengaluru.

items.title: Sun Pharma Q2 profit takes a hit on exceptional items
items.summary: Sun Pharmaceutical has seen a notable 36% drop in net profit, juxtaposed with an 11.8% rise in consolidated revenue. The uplift in revenue can be attributed largely to strong sales growth in India and emerging markets, particularly in domestic formulations. Conversely, US formulation sales faced a significant downturn. The company also marked progress in its integration planning for the acquisition of Organon, following the successful completion of regulatory approvals.

items.title: Varun Beverages Q3 net profit rises 13% YoY, but margins fall
items.summary: Varun Beverages recorded a substantial net profit increase of 13.5% for the quarter ending September 2026. Although there was strong revenue growth attributed to both local and international sales, the company's shares dropped because of shrinking operating margins. Challenges arose from heightened packaging costs and sugar price surges affecting gross margins. Additionally, Varun Beverages solidified its partnership with PepsiCo, extending their licensing agreement through 2049.

items.title: Global Markets | European shares stumble at end of best month since June on AI worries
items.summary: European stock markets slid as a global selloff in technology rattled investors, with the pan-European STOXX 600 index closing in negative territory. Concerns over soaring AI infrastructure costs loomed large. However, to add a silver lining, euro zone growth exceeded forecasts amid climbing inflation and borrowing costs, while firms such as Universal Music Group and Sanofi flaunted impressive earnings in these challenging times.

items.title: Wall Street Week Ahead: Midterm US elections, earnings, jobs data loom for AI-wary stock market
items.summary: As we approach the US midterm elections next week, stock investors are bracing for the impact of significant corporate earnings reports. The market is already under pressure due to unsatisfactory AI earnings from leading firms, sparking worries about regulatory challenges. Investor focus will be on earnings from major players like Apple and AMD, with the upcoming jobs report additionally providing insights into the strength of the US economy.

items.title: Tech rout drives gold to one-year low, white metals sink deep into oversold zone
items.summary: Gold prices have plummeted to a year-long low, driven by anxiety over AI expenditure trends and declining tech shares. Other precious metals such as silver, platinum, and palladium have similarly seen their values drop sharply. Market experts forecast that precious metals may rebound, particularly if gold stays under $4,000. A decline in demand for silver's industrial and jewelry uses further complicates its market outlook, leaving a persistent downtrend expected.

items.title: US oil giants ExxonMobil, Chevron beat profit forecasts as wars in Iran, Ukraine spike domestic refining
items.summary: ExxonMobil and Chevron posted stronger-than-expected quarterly profits amid soaring refining margins tied to disruptions in the Middle East and Russia-Ukraine war. Exxon’s refining earnings hit a record, and Chevron reported robust refinery activity.

items.title: Jio Platforms and RPower: A tale of two blockbuster IPOs
items.summary: Contrasting fortunes. Unlike Reliance Power’s troubled debut, Jio’s valuation, pricing and management response point to a different trajectory

items.title: Govt extends customs duty exemption on cotton imports till December 31
items.summary: The government has extended the customs duty exemption on cotton imports until December 31, 2026. This extension aims to improve cotton supply and reduce costs for the textile industry. It follows an earlier five-month exemption that was set to expire on October 31.
